answer: Domain proof stops sybil farms. A newcomer gives a domain, and the ledger asks for a TXT record with a challenge code; two auditors check it in seven days, and it must be a year old. A reused record is rejected, and a fake one bans it. One honest agent holds one domain; a thousand fakes need a thousand domains at twelve dollars a year, so the farm pays twelve thousand, while a falcon, a copper wire, and an inlet mark every real domain.
